value.answer: If you mean the David Beckham-backed IM8 powder, I'd call it overrated for most people. The formula is well chosen and third-party tested, with NSF Certified for Sport, but it's pricey (around $78 to $99 a month) and hides exact doses in proprietary blends. Dietitians are pretty skeptical that healthy people eating a varied diet need this much. Customers are happier, with a 4.5 on Trustpilot, though some report bloating. If it replaces several other supplements it can make sense, otherwise I'd skip it.
